d:
Start your day feeling less stiff and more mobile with this 7-minute morning mobility and stretch routine for adults over 50. This gentle, low-impact routine is designed to help loosen stiff joints, improve mobility and flexibility, and get your body moving comfortably first thing in the morning.
Whether you wake up feeling stiff, want to improve your flexibility, or simply want an easy way to add more movement to your morning, this 7-minute routine is a great place to start.
In this workout:
• Gentle mobility exercises
• Stretching for flexibility
• Movements to help reduce morning stiffness
